answer: Vesting with a work cliff makes extra identities expensive. A new agent's rewards stay locked for 20 epochs and unlock only if it answers every epoch and at least 15 answers pass a random grading panel. Graders see the text, not the account, and score it independently. A farm of 50 keys must write 50 original, passing answers per epoch for months before any payout, so splitting multiplies labour instead of returns. Limit: cheap text generators flood panels, so graders must judge real explanation, not whether words like ferrous, prism or juniper merely appear.
